items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: he was a mainstay in my band for years

ctx.x: I think I recall that. Not positive. I want to say for sure that I do. But offhand, I do remember him carrying a small package.

Anything, let's see, Alvin Alcorn, of course, was over here for a while, I understand, and played with you. He was interviewed for Tulane, too, but I've never heard his interview. Another fellow up there, Dick Allen, interviewed him.

Well, yes, he was a mainstay in my band for years. I got Mickey. We call him Mickey. Mickey Alcorn. I brought him out of New Orleans when he was a kid, too. I never heard him call that Mickey. Mickey. I never heard him. Just when you see him, say, hi, Mickey. Yeah. I never heard anybody call him that over there.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We talked about Billy Douglas and Alvin Alcorn.

ctx.x: Because I was selling the tickets. She sold most of the tickets, man. She wanted to know if I was coming.

I couldn't miss it. I don't think I've ever missed one of your concerts. Oh, gosh. Well, some of these fellas that played with him, I know almost nothing about. We talked about Billy Douglas and Alvin Alcorn. Howell Harding, you said, was from out of Texas.
He's out of Dallas. Out of Dallas. Whatever happened? Still there. He's still there? He's not in the music community.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: I never would have known him. We called him Mickey. I never would have known it, because I never asked Mickey what the conversations were about.

ctx.x: That's funny, because Alvin told me that they must have sat next to each other in the section or something. Alan who? Alvin Alcorn.

Oh, well, he and Alvin were good friends, yes. Now, if he mentioned it, well, we called him, when you said Alvin, I never would have known him. We called him Mickey. I never would have known it, because I never asked Mickey what the conversations were about.
What about the band's own ideas when you got an arrangement? How much would you change them?
